articles.title: NCLAT revives Walchandnagar Industries' insolvency plea against Swaraj India Agro on SC
articles.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal restored an appeal from Walchandnagar Industries against Swaraj India Agro. The dispute involves operational debts related to a sugar plant project initiated in 2013.

articles.title_hinglish: drishyama da kanklujana boksa ऑphisa kalekshana dina 16: ajaya devagana ki philma men 61% ka uchhala dekha gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: drishyama da kanklujana boksa ऑphisa kalekshana (pisi: instagrama) ajaya devagana ki drishyam: da kanklujana ne apane tisare shanivara ko boksa ऑphisa kalekshana men uchhala darja kiya hai। kraima thrilara ne 16ven dina bharata men anumanita 5 karoda rupaye ki kamaee ki, jo shukravara ke 3.10 karoda rupaye se 61.3% adhika hai।

articles.title: Mizoram’s Hnahsin Kut ends: Cosmos festival in Champhai logs 22.5 million social reach
articles.summary: Hnahsin Kut, also known as the Cosmos Festival, recently concluded in Champhai after eleven days of celebration. Organised by Champhai Nature Conservancy, the festival highlighted the importance of community-led tourism initiatives. The event attracted significant participation, boosting local tourism and economy through stalls and entertainment. Visitors were encouraged to explore Champhai's natural and cultural attractions beyond the festival grounds.

articles.title: Sikkim CM Prem Singh Tamang mourns Kolkata stampede victims, extends condolences
articles.summary: Sikkim Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang expressed grief over the stampede-like incident at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata, which claimed 19 lives, and extended his condolences to the families of the deceased. Tamang said he was “deeply shocked and saddened” by the tragedy, which also left several people injured.
articles.title_hi: सिक्किम के मुख्यमंत्री प्रेम सिंह तमांग ने कोलकाता भगदड़ पीड़ितों के प्रति शोक जताया, संवेदना व्यक्त की
articles.summary_hi: सिक्किम के मुख्यमंत्री प्रेम सिंह तमांग ने कोलकाता के चोरबागान सर्बोजनिन दुर्गा पूजा पंडाल में भगदड़ जैसी घटना पर दुख व्यक्त किया, जिसमें 19 लोगों की मौत हो गई, और मृतकों के परिवारों के प्रति अपनी संवेदना व्यक्त की। तमांग ने कहा कि वह इस त्रासदी से "गहरे सदमे और दुखी" हैं, जिसमें कई लोग घायल भी हुए हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: sikkima ke mukhyamantri prema sinha tamanga ne kolakata bhagadada pidaिton ke prati shoka jatay, sanvedana vyakta ki
articles.summary_hinglish: sikkima ke mukhyamantri prema sinha tamanga ne kolakata ke chorabagana sarbojanina durga puja pandala men bhagadada jaisi ghatana para dukha vyakta kiy, jisamen 19 logon ki mauta ho gaee, aura mritakon ke parivaron ke prati apani sanvedana vyakta ki। tamanga ne kaha ki vaha isa trasadi se "gahare sadame aura dukhi" hain, jisamen kaee loga ghayala bhi hue hain।

articles.title: IAF helicopter rescues 12 stranded overnight by Indravati floods in Chhattisgarh
articles.summary: An Indian Air Force helicopter rescued 12 people stranded by flooding of the Indravati River. The rescue operation followed a distress call regarding civilians trapped in kutcha huts. Doctors at Jagdalpur Medical College are treating flood-affected patients, including children with illnesses. Relief teams are closely monitoring the river levels and providing assistance to affected families.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय वायुसेना के हेलीकॉप्टर ने छत्तीसगढ़ में इंद्रावती बाढ़ में फंसे 12 लोगों को रात भर बचाया
articles.summary_hi: भारतीय वायु सेना के एक हेलीकॉप्टर ने इंद्रावती नदी की बाढ़ में फंसे 12 लोगों को बचाया। बचाव अभियान कच्ची झोपड़ियों में फंसे नागरिकों के संबंध में एक संकटपूर्ण कॉल के बाद चलाया गया। जगदलपुर मेडिकल कॉलेज के डॉक्टर बाढ़ प्रभावित मरीजों का इलाज कर रहे हैं, जिनमें बीमार बच्चे भी शामिल हैं। राहत दल नदी के स्तर की बारीकी से निगरानी कर रहे हैं और प्रभावित परिवारों को सहायता प्रदान कर रहे हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: bharatiya vayusena ke helikoptara ne chhattisagadha men indravati badha men phanse 12 logon ko rata bhara bachaya
articles.summary_hinglish: bharatiya vayu sena ke eka helikoptara ne indravati nadi ki badha men phanse 12 logon ko bachaya। bachava abhiyana kachchi jhopadaिyon men phanse nagarikon ke sanbandha men eka sankatapurna kola ke bada chalaya gaya। jagadalapura medikala koleja ke doktara badha prabhavita marijon ka ilaja kara rahe hain, jinamen bimara bachche bhi shamila hain। rahata dala nadi ke stara ki bariki se nigarani kara rahe hain aura prabhavita parivaron ko sahayata pradana kara rahe hain।

articles.title: Telangana issues guidelines for road safety fund management
articles.summary: He said the measures were aimed at strengthening road safety management, reducing accidents and protecting lives across Telangana. Accounts relating to the funds at both state and district levels will be subject to mandatory CAG audits.

articles.title_hinglish: telangana ne sadaka suraksha nidhi prabandhana ke lie dishanirdesha jari kie

articles.title: Tamil Nadu political party official arrested over huge drug seizure
articles.summary: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence officers arrested a local functionary of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam party in Tamil Nadu after seizing over one hundred kilograms of methamphetamine. The suspect was linked to a drug network moving narcotics toward Sri Lanka. The party promptly expelled him following the arrest, prompting criticism and demands for a full investigation into the wider network.

articles.title: Arunachal Pradesh begins Ranji Trophy campaign from Round 2 after forfeiting opening match
articles.summary: | Photo Credit: VIJAY SONEJI Arunachal Pradesh finally began its Ranji Trophy campaign in Plate group after it had forfeited the opening round match against Nagaland amid a legal dispute within state association. Arunachal is hosting Sikkim in Round 2 at the Gokulbhai Somabhai Patel Stadium in Nadiad. Neelam Obi will lead Arunachal with Kamsha Yangfo as his deputy.

articles.title: Svayam, UN and UNESCO join hands to make Durga Puja accessible across Delhi NCR
articles.summary: This year’s programme seeks to make every aspect of the Puja experience more inclusive, from reaching the idol and participating in rituals to watching cultural performances and sharing bhog. Participating committees are introducing measures suited to their respective venues, including levelled pathways, ramps, wheelchair facilities, designated seating, accessible information and spaces for visitors with sensory sensitivities.

articles.title: Political movements beyond the Congress challenge opposition unity efforts
articles.summary: Political movements outside the Indian National Congress are testing Rahul Gandhi's recent call for strong opposition unity. Civil society groups and grassroots campaigns across India are organizing independent protests regarding various socio-economic issues. Observers note these developments will significantly shape future political alliances and determine whether fragmented opposition forces can mount a coherent challenge to the ruling government.
articles.title_hi: कांग्रेस से परे राजनीतिक आंदोलन विपक्षी एकता के प्रयासों को चुनौती देते हैं
articles.summary_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के बाहर के राजनीतिक आंदोलन मजबूत विपक्षी एकता के लिए राहुल गांधी के हालिया आह्वान का परीक्षण कर रहे हैं। पूरे भारत में नागरिक समाज समूह और जमीनी स्तर के अभियान विभिन्न सामाजिक-आर्थिक मुद्दों को लेकर स्वतंत्र विरोध प्रदर्शन आयोजित कर रहे हैं। पर्यवेक्षकों का कहना है कि ये घटनाक्रम भविष्य के राजनीतिक गठबंधनों को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से आकार देंगे और यह निर्धारित करेंगे कि क्या खंडित विपक्षी ताकतें सत्तारूढ़ सरकार के लिए एक सुसंगत चुनौती पेश कर सकती हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: kangresa se pare rajanitika aandolana vipakshi ekata ke prayason ko chunauti dete hain
articles.summary_hinglish: bharatiya rashtriya kangresa ke bahara ke rajanitika aandolana majabuta vipakshi ekata ke lie rahula gandhi ke haliya aahvana ka parikshana kara rahe hain। pure bharata men nagarika samaja samuha aura jamini stara ke abhiyana vibhinna samajika-aarthika muddon ko lekara svatantra virodha pradarshana aayojita kara rahe hain। paryavekshakon ka kahana hai ki ye ghatanakrama bhavishya ke rajanitika gathabandhanon ko mahatvapurna rupa se aakara denge aura yaha nirdharita karenge ki kya khandita vipakshi takaten sattarudha sarakara ke lie eka susangata chunauti pesha kara sakati hain।

articles.title: Forget Grassroots, Get a Photo-Ready Athlete: The Trap Indian Sport Needs to Avoid
articles.summary: Indian sport has changed over the past few years, and in most cases, for the better. There is significantly greater support from both the public and private sectors, and funding is no longer the constraint it once was. Athletes are backed by multiple initiatives of the Government of India, while private players are investing crores of rupees.

articles.title: NSUI holds candle march in Delhi, demands justice for Ankita Bhandari
articles.summary: The National Students Union of India (NSUI) on Saturday took out a candle march in the national capital, demanding justice for Ankita Bhandari, amid heavy police deployment around the protest site. Advertisement Led by NSUI national president Vinod Jakhar, the march began at the organisation’s national headquarters, with protesters raising slogans demanding justice and accountability.

articles.title: Fairfax IDBI Bank Deal: ₹52,878 Crore Stake Sale
articles.summary: The Fairfax IDBI Bank deal involves the sale of a 60. 72% stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings for ₹52,878 crore, following approval from the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA). The Toronto-based financial services group, backed by Indian Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa, is expected to complete the acquisition by March 2027.
articles.title_hi: फेयरफैक्स आईडीबीआई बैंक डील: ₹52,878 करोड़ हिस्सेदारी बिक्री
articles.summary_hi: फेयरफैक्स आईडीबीआई बैंक सौदे में आर्थिक मामलों की कैबिनेट समिति (सीसीईए) की मंजूरी के बाद, फेयरफैक्स फाइनेंशियल होल्डिंग्स को ₹52,878 करोड़ में आईडीबीआई बैंक में 60.72% हिस्सेदारी की बिक्री शामिल है। भारतीय कनाडाई अरबपति प्रेम वत्स द्वारा समर्थित टोरंटो स्थित वित्तीय सेवा समूह को मार्च 2027 तक अधिग्रहण पूरा करने की उम्मीद है।
articles.title_hinglish: pheyaraphaiksa aaeedibiaaee bainka dil: ₹52,878 karoda hissedari bikri
articles.summary_hinglish: pheyaraphaiksa aaeedibiaaee bainka saude men aarthika mamalon ki kaibineta samiti (sisieee) ki manjuri ke bad, pheyaraphaiksa phainenshiyala holdingsa ko ₹52,878 karoda men aaeedibiaaee bainka men 60.72% hissedari ki bikri shamila hai। bharatiya kanadaee arabapati prema vatsa dvara samarthita toranto sthita vittiya seva samuha ko marcha 2027 taka adhigrahana pura karane ki ummida hai।

articles.title: Rain alert remains in Rajasthan today: Light clouds over Jaipur, Bhilwara and Rajsamand
articles.summary: The western disturbance continued to have a mild impact on Rajasthan on Saturday. Light clouds covered the sky in parts of Jaipur, Bhilwara, Rajsamand and Sirohi, with light drizzle reported at some places. Weak sunshine and winds brought a slight chill during the day in most cities across the state.
